content_of_post_to_comment: It’s insane to me that people throw their books in the trash once they’re done reading them I grew up in a household that valued reading extremely heavily so books were somewhat sacred. I’ve always sold any books. I didn’t feel I needed to keep… What do you guys do?
comment: I think there's a difference between treating books as sacred and treating them as possessions. Passing a book along might actually be a way of respecting it more than letting it collect dust on a shelf.
